extraction.text:
VijayaLakshmi M

Location: Bangalore Contact: +91-9900310416

Email:  tovijayam@gmail.com

SAP Techno Functional Consultant - ABAP/EWM / SDM/TM/ SCM 

Personal Profile

Overall, 12+ Years of SAP HANA EWM, SAP HANA ABAP and Data Migration Experience. Worked on 2 Full life cycle implementation projects

Strong experience on Secondary Distribution management and EWM

Done Integration Between IDM/SDM/EWM

SAP Certified Application Associate - Transportation Management in SAP

SAP Certified Application Associate – SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, Extended Warehouse Management

Outbound / Inbound Process between IDM/SDM/EWM

Gained a good knowledge on the Oil-specific which will be used for the petroleum industry projects.

Participated in the business and technical workshops at client locations. Published business blueprint, high level and low-level design documents.

Experienced in collaborating with multiple teams such as business users, cross functional teams, enterprise IT service groups, management to devise a data integration and migration strategy that addresses delivery requirements

Technical Skills

Technology SAP ECC,SAP HANA 1709,SAP HANA 1909,MS-SQL,SAP HANA STUDIO, Informatica ETL(Basic) Tools Jira, DMC, SDI, Direct data transfer,IDM,PAT,SNOW,SERVICE NOW Database SQL Server, SAP HANA, JD Edwards Testing JIRA, Solman, Automation. Operating Systems Windows Servers, Windows XP Others MS Office, Power point, IBM Blue works, Mural Methodologies Agile (SCRUM,KANBAN).

   
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Techno Functional Consultant - July 2011 to till date (IBM India Pvt Ltd)

Software engineer - Feb 2007 to July 2011 in Satyam computers (Tech Mahindra)

Project # 1: (Implementation)

Organization: - IBM India Pvt.Ltd 

Client: VIVO Energy 

Duration: Aug 2023 to Till Date

Role: SAP EWM Techno functional / SAP IS-OIL Consultant

Industry Vertical: Chemical and Petroleum Industry.

 Responsibilities:

SAP SDM Implementation on the date to day Logistics process according to the Business Requirements.

Sales Order ATP Setup and Customer master setup for Trip planning

Delivery Zone Assignments, PAT Process Rule Configurations

Integration Between SDM/EWM, Outbound / Inbound QRFC Setup

TU Creation in EWM And Assign Deliveries to the TU

Set up PPF Action at Check out in EWM To trigger Inbound

Create Billing document And Freight Po in S4

Material Management

Knowledge on POSC, LOSC, WOCR Process

Batch Management and Stock Alignment, Physical inventory

Replenishment Process

Supporting the super users in solving the issues in the UAT.

Hypercare support for the 2 months after the go live.

Perform the mockup runs in the pre-prod system, analyze the failures, issues and fix in code.

Perform the cutover tasks for the go live.

Project # 2: (Implementation)

Organization: - IBM India Pvt.Ltd.

Client:  MLIT BUILD, India 

Duration: March 2016 to July 2023

Role: SAP HANA Techno Functional Consultant.

Industry Vertical: Travel And Transportation. 

 Responsibilities:

Analyzing the functional specifications and checking out the technical feasibility of the development and then providing the sizing required for development.

Designing of the Technical design documents and Preparing Unit test cases, Code review checklist, Functional specification review checklist.

Worked on Many Developments in Marine area like Storage, Gate moves, Reefer etc.

Experience on Outbound and inbound process

Worked on Maestro rate repository implementation

Involved in end-to-end implementation of TAR Developments

Working with Product Owners to analysing data migration requirements and the make-up of legacy data.

Understanding the business process and helping the end users in solving the issues.

Coordinating with interface teams and Client to deliver requirements on time.

Designing various processes and system improvements to increase productivity.

Create Technical Specification documents by utilizing Data migration experience which will be used in creation of Data services Jobs.

Preload and post load validation of migration results, handle dropouts and advise on data cleansing requirements.

Perform migration dress rehearsals, migration cutover tasks and post go-live support.

Involved in the process of Balance reduction in PTP Area

Actively participated in the process of Data migration Reconciliation

Used LSMW, LTMC tools to load data into SAP ECC, S4 sources such as flat files, Legacy applications etc.

Project # 3: (Implementation)

Organization: - IBM India Pvt.Ltd. 

Client: TOTAL EMEA West

Duration: March 2014 – March 2016

Role: SAP Workflow Consultant

Industry Vertical: Oil and gas down streaming.

 Responsibilities:

Analyzing the functional specifications and checking out the technical feasibility of the development and then providing the sizing required for development.

Designing of the Technical design documents and Preparing Unit test cases, Code review checklist, Functional specification review checklist.

Provide support to end – end application i.e. Front end and back-end application

Front application: Internet Service (Java script, Html)

Back-end application:  SAP Workflow

Created enhancement implementation to Restrict user to create PR s without header text and attachments (Attachments and header text are mandatory to create PR )

Created a report which is used to send mail notification to the user for approval of PR, PO, Contracts

Project # 4: (Implementation)

Organization: - IBM India Pvt.Ltd. 

Client:  IBM Own Project (Blue Harmony) 

Duration: July 2011 - March 2014

Role: SAP Workflow Consultant

Industry Vertical: Finance.

 Responsibilities:

Analyzing the functional specifications and checking out the technical feasibility of the development and then providing the sizing required for development.

Provide solution to complex technical issues and review technical delivery for work pertaining to team members.

Designing of the Technical design documents and Preparing Unit test cases, Code review checklist, Functional specification review checklist.

Actively worked with the Functional consultants to give them technical inputs and resolve the issues at the configuration level.

Participated in OAT, UAT, SIT, Hyper care & production support phases of BH Release 1.0

Worked on billing workflows like Flexible invoice application

Worked on load items for pre-billing Workflow

Worked on action required for prebilling Workflow

Worked on Project Admin Notification for Prebilling Workflow

Worked on Project systems like Workflow for Price case Transformation

Worked on Dispatch and deliver like Missing batch cost

Worked on BHMini-master Maintenance Request Process (Enable / Disable/Update Request)

Education

MCA from Sri Krishna Devaraya University, 2005.

Declaration

I hereby declare that the above information is true to the best of my Knowledge 

Place:  Bangalore

VijayaLakshmi M
